practical-sql.name: Practical SQL
practical-sql.description: Short, practical posts on SQL and BigQuery — from core language features to advanced query patterns. A reference for data practitioners at every level.

bigquery-performance.name: BigQuery Performance
bigquery-performance.description: Practical guides to making BigQuery queries faster and cheaper — partitioning, clustering, search indexes, time travel, cost optimization, and query tuning strategies.

bigquery-arrays-and-structs.name: BigQuery Arrays & Structs
bigquery-arrays-and-structs.description: Everything you need to work effectively with nested and repeated data in BigQuery — ARRAY, STRUCT, UNNEST, ARRAY_AGG, and related functions.

bigquery-window-functions.name: BigQuery Window Functions
bigquery-window-functions.description: A focused guide to window functions in BigQuery — cumulative sums, rolling averages, ranking functions, named windows, RANGE frames, and more.

data-ops.name: Data Ops
data-ops.description: Hands-on guides to data tooling, infrastructure, and operations — scheduling, pipelines, access control, and the engineering behind data workflows.

my-data-journey.name: My Data Journey
my-data-journey.description: Personal reflections, lessons learned, and project deep-dives from a data engineer's career — tools, decisions, and the occasional hard truth.

bigquery-json.name: BigQuery JSON
bigquery-json.description: Working with JSON in BigQuery — the native JSON datatype, extracting and transforming JSON data, LAX conversion functions, and handling semi-structured payloads.

python.name: Python for Data Engineers
python.description: Concise guides to Python features and patterns most useful for data engineering — from built-ins to standard library modules.
